UPDATE pre_blasts
     SET ao = $2,
         channel_id = $3,
         title = $4,
         qs = $5,
         date = $6,
         start_time = $7,
         why = $8,
         equipment = $9,
         fng_message = $10,
         mole_skin = $11,
         img_ids = COALESCE($12, img_ids),
         location_url = $13
     WHERE id = $1
